title: UAE unveils lander for bold 7-asteroid mission set to launch in 2028 (photos)
caption:
The UAE is gearing up for a bold mission to the asteroid belt. By 2036, their autonomous lander will target 269 Justitia, a mysterious red asteroid that may hold the secrets to our solar system's origins. #uae #spaceexploration #asteroid #space #science
